metadata.description: Marketplace for the book-to-course skill — turn books into interactive courses.

plugins.name: book-to-course
plugins.description: Turn a book or document (EPUB, PDF, HTML, DOCX, Markdown, TXT) into an interactive, beginner-friendly course delivered as a local web page; plus course-to-apk (offline Android app, APK) and course-to-appimage (Linux desktop app, AppImage).
